sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that setback, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and will face a struggling Alsager side bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Saturday's fixture list sees all ten other matches kick off simultaneously at 15:00, creating a tightly congested gameweek. Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host Dawley Town in a key opportunity to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth entertain Eccleshall—a clash between two strong sides currently on contrasting form, with Bridgnorth having won three consecutive games. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday before a midweek return fixture at home on Wednesday; Wednesfield are in decent recent form with a win in their last game. Bilston Town face Foley Meir, with both sides looking to consolidate mid-table positions. Brereton Social host Widnes Town in a fixture between two struggling sides, then face Wednesfield on Wednesday evening. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills in a meeting of mid-table teams, while Crewe host Allscott Heath and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in contests between sides searching for consistency. Shawbury United visit Barnton in a clash involving teams currently in the lower reaches of the table.
